sides.name: Macedon and the Hellenic League (Alexander III)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. Arrian 40,000 foot / 7,000 horse, broadly accepted by modern historians: 31,000 heavy infantry (phalanx, hypaspists, Greek hoplites), 9,000 light, 7,000 cavalry. Light split into peltasts/Agrianians vs archers, and cavalry into Companions+Thessalians (heavy) vs prodromoi/Paeonians/mercenaries (light), is an educated guess. Weapons 3.0 = sarissa anchor. Command 1.0: Alexander (best-in-era). Training 0.95: long-service veterans.

sides.name: Achaemenid Empire (Darius III)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. Modern estimates 52,000-268,000 (Bichler survey); Warry 91,000, Harbottle 120,000, Engels and Green <=100,000. Mid ~93,000. Ancient 250,000-1,000,000 (Arrian, Diodorus, Curtius, Plutarch) rejected. Cavalry 12,000-45,000; Immortals 10,000 and Greek mercenaries 2,000-8,000 in infantry_line. Role split is derived from the Wikipedia low/high table, grade C. 200 scythed chariots (ancient, plausible). 15 elephants present but not used, mid 0. Prepared, levelled ground for the chariots. Command 0.4: Darius fled; coordination of satrapal contingents poor.

outcome.note: Macedonian victory. Ancient Macedonian dead 1,100-1,500 (Arrian/Curtius/Diodorus), wounded not reported; mid 3,000 assumes ~1.5 wounded per killed (derived). Persian dead 40,000 (Curtius) to 90,000 (Diodorus), Arrian claims 300,000 captured (absurd). Mid 35,000 is an educated guess (~1/3 of mid strength), grade C.
